definition.en: A measurement taken all the way around the body at a named place — chest, waist, hip, neck, head, wrist. Girths are the backbone of a made-to-measure draft because they are the measurements a garment has to enclose, and they are the ones a person can take on themselves with a tape and no help.
definition.es: Una medida tomada alrededor del cuerpo en un lugar con nombre — pecho, cintura, cadera, cuello, cabeza, muñeca. Los contornos son la columna vertebral de un trazo a medida porque son las medidas que una prenda debe rodear, y son las que una persona puede tomarse a sí misma con una cinta y sin ayuda.
definition.fr: Une mesure prise tout autour du corps à un endroit nommé — poitrine, taille, hanches, cou, tête, poignet. Les tours sont l'ossature d'un tracé sur mesure parce que ce sont les mesures qu'un vêtement doit enfermer, et celles qu'une personne peut prendre seule avec un mètre ruban.
definition.pt: Uma medida tirada à volta do corpo num lugar com nome — peito, cintura, anca, pescoço, cabeça, pulso. Os perímetros são a espinha dorsal de um traçado à medida porque são as medidas que uma peça tem de envolver, e são as que uma pessoa consegue tirar sozinha com uma fita.

aliases.note: The solid side's spelling on the body-form family — the same ISO 8559 places rendered as surface interfaces on a mannequin.

constraints: A girth is a body measurement, never a garment one: the finished garment measures the girth plus its ease (or minus its negative ease), and a draft that treats the two as the same number produces a garment exactly one ease too small.
